leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Read page and sort query parameters from ActivatedRoute.queryParams as an Observable and combine them with combineLatest
Use switchMap to trigger an HTTP request whenever the combined query parameters change, cancelling stale requests
Navigate to updated query params on page or sort change using queryParamsHandling:'merge' to preserve other params
Display a loading state and empty state using the async pipe's structural directives without any component-level subscription
Apply shareReplay(1) in the data service so navigating back to this route does not re-fire the same HTTP request
Implement a sort header that cycles through ascending, descending, and unsorted states and encodes the result in the URL
Test the component by providing a mock ActivatedRoute with queryParams as a BehaviorSubject and verifying HTTP call triggers
